title: Applying Social Media Intelligence for Predicting and Identifying On-line Radicalization and Civil Unrest Oriented Threats
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review that includes religion as a core dimension (Genre G5) in its classification framework for radicalization research. It specifically analyzes how machine learning and NLP techniques are used to identify and categorize content related to religious extremist ideologies, such as Jihad and anti-religious propaganda.
